reasons: Classification is correct: both clauses auto-renew but require six (6) months (~180 days) and twelve (12) months (~365 days) non-renewal notice, well beyond the fallback ceiling of 60 days and inside the rule's walk-away band (>90 days), so this is a material deviation rather than an acceptable fallback.

Redline is valid and directionally right: notice windows reduced to thirty (30) days and renewal periods aligned at twelve (12) months, matching the redline guidance; the SOW's inverted structure (12-month notice against a 6-month renewal term) is properly corrected.

Edits are surgical — only the notice-period and renewal-length numerals change, leaving 'same terms and conditions' and cross-references intact; the advisory changed-character ratios (0.32/0.29) reflect the numeral substitutions, not a rewrite.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required tone with the [Playbook] prefix, cites the playbook position and offers the 60-day fallback.

Absent vendor reminder and price-uplift cap are correctly noted in the rationale rather than pressed as separate deviations, consistent with the sub-element guidance; renewals continuing on the same terms limits uplift risk.
